scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Hey hey. I don't have time for chit-chat, I'm a pretty busy guy. There's all these Merchants working hard to become Blacksmiths.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
嘿，嘿。我没时间闲聊，我可是个大忙人。这里有很多商人正在努力成为铁匠。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Wait a minute, I think I've met you before.
Ummm.....
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
等一下，我想我以前见过你。
嗯……

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Are you the one who broke my weapon and ran away? Or are you the one who tortured me so that I'd forge a weapon for you? Why can't I remember?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你是那个弄坏我的武器然后逃跑的人吗？还是那个折磨我让我为你锻造武器的人？为什么我想不起来了？

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
.......
I can't remember who you are for the life of me. Is this deja vu?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
……
我怎么也想不起你是谁。这是似曾相识的感觉吗？

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Argh!! This is really bugging me! But still, I can sense that there's something special about you. Oh well, whatever. Have a good day~
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
啊！！这真让我心烦！不过，我还是能感觉到你有些特别之处。算了，祝你愉快~

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Welcome!
We are Workers of Steel,
the Blacksmith Guild.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
欢迎！
我们是钢铁工人，
也就是铁匠公会。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
We pour the fervor
and passion of our souls into
our craft. Our skills of melting metal into new weapons
and tools is truly a form of art!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
我们将灵魂的热情
和激情倾注于
我们的工艺之中。将金属熔炼成新武器
和工具的技能确实是一种艺术！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You... look like a stranger. But somehow it seems that you're related to our guild. Haha~
Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你……看起来像个陌生人。但不知为何，你似乎与我们公会有关系。哈哈~
我说得对吗？

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Oh~
what a very
pretty lady!
Are you interested in
becoming a Blacksmith?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
哦~
多么漂亮的
女士啊！
你有兴趣
成为铁匠吗？

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Are you interested in
becoming a Blacksmith?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你有兴趣
成为铁匠吗？

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
First, you must become a Merchant before you can become a Blacksmith. Go to the city of Alberta to learn the Merchant trade.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
首先，你必须先成为商人，然后才能成为铁匠。去艾尔贝塔城学习商人的贸易吧。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Oh, are you interested in having a weapon forged? I'm sorry to disappoint you, but I actually have a lot of business to attend to.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
哦，你有兴趣锻造武器吗？很抱歉让你失望了，但我实际上有很多业务要处理。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Oh...
There's not much we can offer you here. And you can't really help out around here unless you know how to make stuff...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
哦……
我们这里没什么能帮你的。而且如果你不懂怎么制造东西，你也帮不上什么忙……

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Oh? What's a magic user doing here? I'm surprised. Usually this kind of rough work is beneath you intellectual types.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
哦？魔法师来这里做什么？我很惊讶。通常这种粗活是配不上你们这些知识分子类型的。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Oh! Am I correct in assuming you're a member of the Clergy? Would you please bless me before you leave!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
哦！我猜你是神职人员的一员吧？在你离开之前能祝福我吗！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
I'm sorry...
But there really isn't anything for you to steal here. Well, there are the Daggers we keep in the back, but...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
抱歉……
但这里真的没什么可偷的。嗯，后面倒是有一些短剑，但是……

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
So how's the pharmacy business going on recently?
Well, my forging business does not seem to grow any longer.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
最近药店生意怎么样？
嗯，我的锻造生意似乎不再增长了。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Oh! Long time no see.
Have you come to purchase supplies from Christopher? These days I'm stuck behind this desk. My body's itching to strike the ol' anvil.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
哦！好久不见。
你是来向克里斯托弗购买补给品的吗？这几天我被困在这张桌子后面。我的身体渴望再次敲击那古老的铁砧。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You can't change to the Blacksmith Job Class without first using all your skill points. Please come back after wisely using your skill points.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
如果不先用完所有的技能点，你就不能转职为铁匠。请在明智地使用完技能点后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Why don't you stop struggling
to make zeny as a Merchant and
join the elite Blacksmith class?
If you're interested, fill out this application with your name
and Job Level.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你为什么不停止作为商人努力赚取泽尼，
而加入精英铁匠阶层呢？
如果你有兴趣，请填写这份申请表，写上你的名字
和职业等级。

scripts.text: Fill out Application.
scripts.translation: 填写申请表。

scripts.text: What are the requirements?
scripts.translation: 有什么要求？

scripts.text: Um, I need to think about it.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我需要再想想。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You can't change to the Blacksmith Job Class without first using all your skill points. Please come back after wisely using your skill points.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
如果不先用完所有的技能点，你就不能转职为铁匠。请在明智地使用完技能点后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Hmmm...
Looks like you
meet the Job Level
Requirement.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
嗯……
看起来你
符合职业等级
的要求。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You see, we don't accept just anybody into our guild. First, we only accept experienced Merchants with a true desire to become great Blacksmiths. Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你看，我们不是随便接受任何人加入公会的。首先，我们只接受那些真正渴望成为伟大铁匠的经验丰富的商人。让我看看……

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Shuffling of papers*^000000

[Altiregen]
Hmmm...
One of our Blacksmiths in Einbech, ^8E6B23Geschupenschte^000000 has sent us word that he's short on help. Your first test of character will be to help him out.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
嗯……
我们在艾音贝赫的一位铁匠，^8E6B23格舒彭什特^000000传来消息说他人手不足。你的第一次性格测试就是去帮助他。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Be careful
and good luck!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
小心点
祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Hmmm, it seems that you lack experience as a Merchant. We require that you are at least Job Level 40, you see.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
嗯，看来你缺乏作为商人的经验。我们需要你至少达到职业等级40，你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
I feel bad turning you away after you've come so far, but rules are rules. Sorry to disappoint you, but we'll welcome you back once you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
在你走了这么远之后拒绝你，我感到很抱歉，但规矩就是规矩。很抱歉让你失望了，但当你准备好时，我们会欢迎你回来。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You want to know our requirements? First, you need to have Job Level 40 or higher as a Merchant. Second, you need to pass a test that will be given by the Blacksmith Guild.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你想知道我们的要求吗？首先，你需要作为商人达到职业等级40或更高。其次，你需要通过铁匠公会进行的测试。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
The test may consist of difficult tasks, but it's definitely not impossible. You will need to deliver certain items to different areas around the world
to complete the test.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
测试可能包含困难的任务，但绝对不是不可能完成的。你需要将某些物品送到世界各地的不同区域
来完成测试。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Hmmm...
Well, I hope
to see you again.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
嗯……
好吧，我希望
能再次见到你。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You haven't left yet?
Go to Einbech and find ^8E6B23Geschupenschte^000000. Finish helping him out, and when you're done, come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你还没走吗？
去艾音贝赫找^8E6B23格舒彭什特^000000。帮他完成工作后，再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Was the work you did for ^8E6B23Geschupenschte^000000 to your liking? He's known for being pretty exacting...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你为^8E6B23格舒彭什特^000000做的工作还满意吗？他以要求严格而闻名……

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Great job!!
You have passed
the first test...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
干得好！！
你已经通过了
第一次测试……

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Hm? You look surprised.
I guess you didn't know that there's more than one test. 
Haha, but don't worry, you are not going to travel that far.
Please go talk to the guildsman inside the building for more details about your next test.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
嗯？你看起来很惊讶。
我想你不知道不止一次测试吧。
哈哈，不过别担心，你不需要去太远的地方。
请去和建筑物内的公会成员谈谈，了解更多关于下一次测试的细节。

scripts.text: I want to change my job quickly! But...oh well.
scripts.translation: 我想快点转职！但是……唉。

scripts.text: Grrr! Enough is enough!
scripts.translation: 够了！受够了！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
I'm sorry, but I'm sure you understand, right? We can't just casually accept anybody into
our guild!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
抱歉，但我相信你能理解，对吧？我们不能随意接受任何人加入
我们的公会！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
If we don't keep our standards,
we won't be able to maintain the respectability of the Blacksmith Guild!
We can't embarass our guild in this manner! *Ahem* Anyway, you talk to the guildsman inside the building now.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
如果我们不保持标准，
我们就无法维持铁匠公会的尊严！
我们不能以这种方式让公会蒙羞！*咳咳* 总之，你现在去和建筑物内的公会成员谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Are you saying you're going
to quit the application process? That's an insult to our guild!
Get out of here! With that kind of attitude, you can forget becoming a member of the Blacksmith Guild!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你是说你要
放弃申请过程吗？那是对我们公会的侮辱！
滚出去！带着那种态度，你休想成为铁匠公会的一员！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You have no spirit!
If you can't endure this, you'll never be a Blacksmith!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你没有精神！
如果你连这个都忍受不了，你永远成不了铁匠！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Um? Haven't you talk to the guildsman yet?
If you haven't, I suggest you to do so as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
嗯？你还没和公会成员谈过吗？
如果还没，我建议你尽快去谈。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You are on a riding pet, so you cannot change your job.
Please unequip your riding pet and try again!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你骑着坐骑宠物，所以不能转职。
请卸下你的坐骑宠物后再试一次！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Excellent, I can tell by the twinkle in your eye that you were successful. I can now bestow upon you the gift of the smithing, the art of the Blacksmith.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
太好了，从你眼中的光芒我可以看出你成功了。我现在可以授予你锻造的礼物，即铁匠的艺术。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Always remember that we are creators, and artists over metals. Be wary that you do not fall into the pitfalls of selfishness
and greed.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
永远记住，我们是创造者，是金属艺术家。要小心不要陷入自私
和贪婪的陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Here is a little
gift to mark the
beginning of your
life as a Blacksmith.
Congratulations!!!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
这里有一份小
礼物，标志着
你作为铁匠
生活的开始。
恭喜！！！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Hello there!
I'm ^8E6B23Geschupenschte^000000,
a Blacksmith by trade.
Nice to meet you!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
你好！
我是^8E6B23格舒彭什特^000000，
一名职业铁匠。
很高兴见到你！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Oh ho ho!
You're a Merchant!
Excellent! I was
in need of some help!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
哦呵呵！
你是个商人！
太好了！我正
需要一些帮助！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
But, of course,
I wouldn't bother you
if you're busy. Go along
your way if you must~
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
当然，
如果你很忙，
我不会打扰你。
如果有事就请便~

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
After all...
I should know
how it's like
to be busy~
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
毕竟……
我应该知道
忙碌是什么
感觉~

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Am I correct in assuming you are the help sent by the Blacksmith Guild? There aren't many trustyworthy people I can hire to help me, so I'm always
short on help.
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
我猜你是铁匠公会派来的帮手吧？我能雇佣的可信赖的人不多，所以我总是
人手不足。

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Hmm, in any case,
you are the help that was sent, right? Okay, I have some work for you that must be handled
right away!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
嗯，不管怎样，
你就是被派来的帮手，对吧？好的，我有一些必须立即
处理的工作给你！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Some time ago, I had a boy working for me who had no experience and bought the wrong supplies! It was terrible...
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
前段时间，我有一个毫无经验的男孩为我工作，他买错了补给品！那真是糟糕……

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Anyone would hate to lose money through a foolish mistake like that. However, I have a slightly more difficult job for you.
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
任何人都会讨厌因为那样愚蠢的错误而赔钱。不过，我给你安排了一个稍微难一点的工作。

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
However, I want to make sure that you have some basic knowledge as a Merchant. I'd like to ask you some questions, if that's okay.
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
不过，我想确保你具备一些作为商人的基本知识。如果可以的话，我想问你一些问题。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的。

scripts.text: Um, can I have some time to prepare?
scripts.translation: 嗯，我能有点时间准备一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
So, have you
studied a little
more this time?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
那么，这次
你有没有
多学习一点？

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
I admit that it's pretty unreasonable to expect anyone to get a perfect score the first time around, so I'll give you
a little break...
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
我承认，指望任何人第一次就得满分是很不合理的，所以我会给你
一点休息……

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
You can miss
one problem!
Alright, let's start
with the questions~
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
你可以错
一道题！
好吧，让我们开始
提问吧~

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
1. Which one of the following regions is matched incorrectly
with its specialty item?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
1. 以下哪个地区与其特产物品的搭配是不正确的？

scripts.text: Morocc - Thief Clothes
scripts.translation: 梦罗克 - 盗贼之衣

scripts.text: Alberta - Two Hand Axe
scripts.translation: 艾尔贝塔 - 双手斧

scripts.text: Comodo - Berserk Potion
scripts.translation: 克魔岛 - 菠色克药水

scripts.text: Alberta - Swordmace
scripts.translation: 艾尔贝塔 - 钉锤

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
2. What status can
be inflicted with the
^8E6B23Hammer Fall^000000 skill?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
2. ^8E6B23大地之击^000000技能可以施加什么状态异常？

scripts.text: Stun
scripts.translation: 眩晕

scripts.text: Blind
scripts.translation: 失明

scripts.text: Silence
scripts.translation: 沉默

scripts.text: Sleep
scripts.translation: 睡眠

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
3. Which one of the following skills cannot be performed
by a Merchant?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
3. 以下哪个技能是商人无法使用的？

scripts.text: Vending
scripts.translation: 露天商店

scripts.text: Discount
scripts.translation: 低价买进

scripts.text: Overcharge
scripts.translation: 高价卖出

scripts.text: Increase AGI
scripts.translation: 增加AGI

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
4. Where can you find a store
that sells Blue Gemstones?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
4. 在哪里可以找到出售蓝色魔力矿石的商店？

scripts.text: Alberta
scripts.translation: 艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Morocc
scripts.translation: 摩洛克

scripts.text: Geffen
scripts.translation: 吉芬

scripts.text: Prontera
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
5. Where is the
Tool Dealer
located in Geffen?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
5. 吉芬的工具商人位于哪里？

scripts.text: 8 o'clock direction from the town square
scripts.translation: 城镇广场8点钟方向

scripts.text: 11 o'clock direction from the town square
scripts.translation: 城镇广场11点钟方向

scripts.text: 6 o'clock direction from the town square
scripts.translation: 城镇广场6点钟方向

scripts.text: 5 o'clock direction from the town square
scripts.translation: 城镇广场5点钟方向

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
6. Which weapon
cannot be used
by a Merchant?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
6. 哪种武器
商人不能使用？

scripts.text: Stiletto
scripts.translation: 匕首

scripts.text: Ring Pommel Saber
scripts.translation: 圆柄马刀

scripts.text: Chain
scripts.translation: 链锤

scripts.text: Bible
scripts.translation: 圣经

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
7. Which one of the following
has the highest defense rate?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
7. 以下哪件装备的防御力最高？

scripts.text: Panties
scripts.translation: 内裤

scripts.text: Mink Coat
scripts.translation: 毛皮大衣

scripts.text: Wooden Mail
scripts.translation: 木制盔甲

scripts.text: Silk Robe
scripts.translation: 丝质外袍

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
8. For Level 3 weapons,
what is the ^8E6B23Safe^000000 limit
for upgrading?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
8. 对于3级武器，^8E6B23安全^000000精炼上限是多少？

scripts.text: up to + 3
up to + 4
up to + 5
up to + 6

9. What item
can be made using
the ^8E6B23Trunks^000000 item?
scripts.translation: 9. 使用^8E6B23树干^000000物品可以制作什么物品？

scripts.text: Sakkat
scripts.translation: 草帽

scripts.text: Ghost Bandana
scripts.translation: 亡者发箍

scripts.text: Majestic Goat
scripts.translation: 山羊角

scripts.text: Antler
scripts.translation: 鹿角

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
10. The most important
part of being a Merchant is...?

回到艾音布罗克的^8E6B23阿尔蒂雷根^000000那里，就是你申请铁匠工作时第一个遇到的人。

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
I have faith that you
will be a great Blacksmith!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
我相信你会成为一名伟大的铁匠！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
You mean...
You didn't get
a receipt?
What...?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
你的意思是……
你没拿到
收据？
什么……？

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
A receipt is
a Merchant's best friend!
It's necessary to your job!
You'll have to start your
test all over again!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
收据是
商人最好的朋友！
这对你的工作至关重要！
你得重新开始你的
测试！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Return when you
find the receipt~
You didn't forget
to receive a receipt.
Right...?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
找到收据后再回来~
你没忘记
领取收据。
对吧……？

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Thank you
very much
your help.
Return to Einbroch
and see ^8E6B23Altiregen^000000!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
非常感谢
你的帮助。
回艾音布罗克
见^8E6B23阿尔蒂雷根^000000！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Hmm...?
You already finished
your test here with me!
And surprisingly, I don't
need any more help, today.
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
嗯……？
你已经在我这里
完成测试了！
而且出乎意料的是，我今天
不需要更多帮助了。

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Being
a Blacksmith
is truly great!
Don't you think so?
Mwahahahahah!!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
成为
铁匠
真是太棒了！
你不这么认为吗？
哇哈哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Oh, hello!
Have you come
to deliver my
Arc Wand?
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
哦，你好！
你是来交付我的
言灵魔杖的吗？

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
You sure this is what I ordered, right? I mean, if it's been used,
I don't want it.
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
你确定这是我订购的吗？我是说，如果是用过的，
我不要。

scripts.text: Whoops, this is one of the items I use...
scripts.translation: 哎呀，这是我使用的物品之一……

scripts.text: I'm sure! It's brand new!
scripts.translation: 我确定！它是全新的！

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Well...
I guess I can
wait a little longer.
Please hurry with
my delivery~
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
好吧……
我想我可以
再等一会儿。
请尽快交付~

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
You're
absolutely sure?
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
你绝对
确定吗？

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Thank you so much for traveling all the way here. That Geschupenschte, please smack him for me when you meet him for being so late on this order...
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
非常感谢你大老远跑来这里。那个格舒彭什特，当你见到他时，请帮我揍他一顿，因为他在这个订单上迟到了这么久……

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Please wait
a second, let
me give you a receipt~
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
请稍等
一下，让我
给你一张收据~

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Here it is.
Thank you so much!
Oh, and good luck~
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
在这里。
非常感谢！
哦，祝你好运~

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Thank you
so much for
the delivery~
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
非常感谢
交付~

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Oh...
It's been a while
since I've been
to Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
哦……
我已经很久
没去过
艾尔贝塔了。

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
I ordered something
from there a while ago,
but I haven't received
my delivery...
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
我前段时间从那里订购了一些东西，
但我还没收到
我的货物……

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
I wonder...
Could the Blacksmith Guild
be undermanned? I can't think of any other reason for them to be late...
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
我在想……
铁匠公会是不是人手不足？我想不出其他他们迟到的原因……

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
When will I get
my special Arc Wand?
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
我什么时候能拿到
我的特制言灵魔杖？

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
...!
It's here!
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
…！
它来了！

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
This is what I ordered, right?
I don't want any used or old Gladius that you might have!
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
这是我订购的，对吧？
我不想要你可能有的任何用过或旧的刺剑！

scripts.text: Whoops, not that one.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，不是那个。

scripts.text: I guarantee you it is new.
scripts.translation: 我保证它是新的。

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Oooh...!
Hurry up
with my Gladius~
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
噢……！
快点把我的
刺剑拿来~

scripts.text: - She seems to be upset. -
scripts.translation: - 她似乎很生气。 -

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Hah hah hah!
Finally! Now...
Let me have
a look!
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
哈哈哈！
终于！现在……
让我看看！

scripts.text: - She looks very happy. -
scripts.translation: - 她看起来很高兴。 -

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Are you with the
Einbroch Blacksmith Guild?
Give this message to Geschupenschte!
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
你是艾音布罗克铁匠公会的吗？
把这个消息带给格舒彭什特！

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
'^660000You're late!
Do you know how long
I've been waiting?!^000000'
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
‘^660000你迟到了！
你知道我等了多久吗？！^000000’

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
But, this is also
a masterfully crafted item.
Tell him I'm satisfied with the quality of the workmanship.
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
不过，这也是
一件工艺精湛的物品。
告诉他我对做工质量很满意。

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Here's the receipt.
I think you did
a good job.
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
这是收据。
我想你做得
不错。

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Thanks for the delivery.
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
谢谢交付。

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
...
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
...

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
...
......

[Wickebine]
They're late.
They're late,
they're late,
they're late~!
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
他们迟到了。
他们迟到了，
他们迟到了，
他们迟到了~！

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
How long does it take for something to ship from Geschupenschte? Usually, the Geffen Blacksmith Guild is pretty prompt...
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
从格舒彭什特那里发货需要多长时间？通常，吉芬铁匠公会很准时……

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Ooohh...
This is very
upsetting...
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
噢……
这真让人
心烦……

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Ohhhhhh~
Is it here?
Very nice.
Let me take a look.
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
哦~~~~
它来了吗？
很好。
让我看看。

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
So you're sure this is the item
I ordered, right? I wouldn't want it if it's been used.
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
所以你确定这是我订购的物品，对吧？如果是用过的我可不要。

scripts.text: Whoops, this one is used!
scripts.translation: 哎呀，这个是用过的！

scripts.text: It was just made, so it's new.
scripts.translation: 它是刚做的，所以是新的。

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Hmmmmm!
Please deliver
the right sword!
I've been waiting
long enough already...
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
嗯~~~~！
请交付
正确的剑！
我已经等了
够久了……

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
You double checked?
Alright then, I'll take it!
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
你仔细检查过了？
好吧，那我收下了！

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Oh ho...
This is good.
Much better than
what I expected.
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
哦呵……
这很好。
比我预期的
好多了。

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
With this sword...
My special moves will be even more powerful! I may even be able to perfect my fast attacking techniques! I love it!
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
有了这把剑……
我的特殊招式将更加强大！我甚至可能完善我的快速攻击技巧！我喜欢它！

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Okay then.
Let me give
you a receipt.
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
好吧。
让我给你
一张收据。

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Here is
your receipt.
Thank you for
your business!
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
这是
你的收据。
感谢你的
惠顾！

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Thank you
for the delivery.
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
谢谢交付。

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
...
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
...

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
...
......

[Krongast]
When will the sword
I ordered finally arrive?
I need to try my ultimate skill, ^2F4F4FFine Edge^000000 with it.
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
我订购的剑什么时候才能最终到达？
我需要用它来尝试我的终极技能，^2F4F4F细刃^000000。

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Ahhhhhhh!
I need to
have that sword!
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
啊啊啊啊啊！
我需要
那把剑！

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Oh~
Is it finally here?
The package I ordered?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
哦~
它终于来了吗？
我订购的包裹？

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Um, this is what I ordered, right? I don't want an Arbalest that's been used before.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
嗯，这是我订购的，对吧？我不想要以前用过的弩弓。

scripts.text: Whoops, this is a used one.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，这是个用过的。

scripts.text: I'm sure it's new.
scripts.translation: 我确定它是新的。

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Hmmmm.
Please hurry
and bring the
correct item.
I've waited too
long already...
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
嗯~~~~。
请快点
带来
正确的物品。
我已经等了太
久了……

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
So, you're sure?
Let me take a look...
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
所以，你确定吗？
让我看看……

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
*wheet whoo*
Very nice!!
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
*呼呜*
非常好！！

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
This is truly a quality made custom item. I love how there is a case for an eye patch! I really reallly love this~
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
这真是一件高质量的定制物品。我喜欢它有一个放独眼龙眼罩的盒子！我真的非常喜欢这个~

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Thank you!
For something of this quality,
I can even sell it for a high price even after I've used it!
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
谢谢！
对于这样质量的东西，
即使我用过之后也能卖个好价钱！

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Here!
Please take
your receipt.
I really appreciate
your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
给！
请收下
你的收据。
我非常感激
你的辛勤工作。

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Really,
I can't say it
enough. This is
top quality work~!
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
真的，
我怎么强调
都不为过。这是
顶级质量的作品~！

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Eh...
When will my
order arrive?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
呃……
我的订单
什么时候到？

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
A custom made Arbalest
with a quality case to hold your eye patches. Only one person can make something like that...
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
带有高质量独眼龙眼罩盒子的定制弩弓。只有一个人能做出这样的东西……

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Ahhhhhh...
The waiting
is unbearable!
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
啊啊啊啊……
等待
令人难以忍受！

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
Sweet God...
Have you sent
an angel...?
Is that the Ring Pommel Saber
I ordered? It's my only hope...
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
甜神啊……
你派来了
天使吗……？
那是我订购的圆柄马刀吗？这是我唯一的希望……

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
^666666*Huuuk*^000000 This is what I ordered, right? I needed one especially
made to stop this poison...
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
^666666*呼*^000000 这是我订购的，对吧？我需要一个特制的来阻止这种毒药……

scripts.text: Whoops, this is my own Ring Pommel Saber.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，这是我自己的圆柄马刀。

scripts.text: I'm sure this is the one.
scripts.translation: 我确定就是这个。

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
N-Nooo...
Hurry...!
I need that
sword for its
an...ti...d-dote!
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
不-不……
快点……！
我需要那把
剑来解...毒...！

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt looks like
he's slowly dying...!
You'd better hurry.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF看起来他
正在慢慢死去……！
你最好快点。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
^666666*Ghklk*^000000
Give it...!
Pleeeease!

^3355FFBismarc stabs
himself, repeatedly,
with the Ring Pommel Saber
that has been imbued with
the power of Green Herbs.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF俾斯麦反复用
蕴含绿色药草力量的
圆柄马刀刺向自己。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
^666666*Ghyklk*^000000
*Gasp gasp*

[Bismarc]
Please...
Help me up.
The poison is
still coarsing
through my body...
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
请……
扶我起来。
毒药仍然在
我体内流动……

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
OwwwWWWW!!
IT'S BURNING!
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
噢WWWW！！
它在燃烧！

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
*Gasp Gasp*
*Whew* Okay,
I can feel the
antidote working now.
Just what I needed.
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
*喘息喘息*
*呼* 好了，
我现在能感觉到
解毒剂起作用了。
正是我需要的。

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
Here is
your receipt.
T-take it...!
It's yours!
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
这是
你的收据。
拿-拿去……！
是你的了！

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
Thank you.
You saved
my life...
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
谢谢。
你救了
我的命……

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
^666666*Ghyklk*^000000
^666666*Huk Hukk*^000000
When will my
o-order arrive...?

[Bismarc]
The poison in
my body... the pain...
excruciating... L-lord...
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
我体内的毒药……疼痛……
剧痛……主-主啊……

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
When is the
antidote gonna
get here?!
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
解毒剂什么时候
能到？！

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
Oh...so you're the one who wants to be a blacksmith?
Nice, heh heh.
As you've realized from your past tests, you won't be promoted from Merchant to Blacksmtih immediately.
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
哦……所以你就是想成为铁匠的人？
不错，嘿嘿。
正如你从之前的测试中意识到的那样，你不会立即从商人晋升为铁匠。

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
How much do you truly understand about smithing? Are you ready for me to ask you some questions?
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
你对锻造了解多少？你准备好让我问你一些问题了吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No, not yet~
scripts.translation: 不，还没~

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
Alright...
My test is simple.
I'll ask five questions.
If you miss too many,
you fail. And I won't
tell you what you missed.
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
好吧……
我的测试很简单。
我会问五个问题。
如果你错太多，
你就失败了。而且我不会
告诉你错在哪里。

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
Please listen
and answer carefully...
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
请仔细听
并回答……

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
1. What ability
is required to learn
the ^8E6B23Discount^000000 skill?
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
1. 学习^8E6B23低价买进^000000技能需要什么能力？

scripts.text: Level 3 Push Cart
scripts.translation: 3级手推车

scripts.text: Item Appraisal
scripts.translation: 物品鉴定

scripts.text: Level 10 Mammonite
scripts.translation: 10级金钱攻击

scripts.text: Level 3 Enlarge Weight
scripts.translation: 3级负重增加

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
2. When you attack
with ^8E6B23Hammerfall^000000,
what status effect can
you inflict on enemies?
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
2. 当你使用^8E6B23大地之击^000000攻击时，可以对敌人施加什么状态异常？

scripts.text: Stun
scripts.translation: 眩晕

scripts.text: Blindness
scripts.translation: 失明

scripts.text: Chaos
scripts.translation: 混乱

scripts.text: Silence
scripts.translation: 沉默

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
3. How much Zeny is spent
when attacking with the
mastered Mammonite skill?
(Level 10 Mammonite)
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
3. 使用精通的金钱攻击技能（10级金钱攻击）攻击时花费多少泽尼？

scripts.text: 900 Zeny
scripts.translation: 900 泽尼

scripts.text: 1000 Zeny
2000 Zeny

[Mitehmaeeuh]
4. What is the
discount rate when
the ^8E6B23Discount^000000
skill is mastered?
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
4. 当^8E6B23低价买进^000000技能精通时，折扣率是多少？

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
5. What is the maximum
percentage that you can
overcharge items sold to
NPCs after mastering the
^8E6B23Overcharge^000000 skill?
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
5. 精通^8E6B23高价卖出^000000技能后，卖给NPC的物品最高可以加价百分之多少？

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
1. Which of the
following monsters
drops Steel?
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
1. 以下哪种魔物会掉落钢？

scripts.text: Zerom
scripts.translation: 杰洛米

scripts.text: Chon Chon
scripts.translation: 虫蛹

scripts.text: Skel Worker
scripts.translation: 骷髅工人

scripts.text: Requiem
scripts.translation: 诺可伊

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
2. Which of the following
stones can be made from
Red Bloods?
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
2. 以下哪种石头可以由火灵原石制成？

scripts.text: Flame Heart
scripts.translation: 火灵原石

scripts.text: Rough Wind
scripts.translation: 风灵原石

scripts.text: Great Nature
scripts.translation: 土灵原石

scripts.text: Mystic Frozen
scripts.translation: 水灵原石

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]

现在我又必须应对艾音布罗克的烟雾！

[Mitehmaeeuh]
We, Blacksmiths are trying our best to forge the best of the best weapons.

[米特梅乌]
我们铁匠正在尽力锻造最好的武器。

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]

我们为此宣誓我们的荣誉！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Good day, are you here to visit Blacksmith Guild?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
你好，你是来参观铁匠公会的吗？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
I thank you for coming this far to visit our guild. However, I regret to inform you that Blacksmith Guild has been
moved to ^3131FF'Einbroch' in the Schwarzwald Republic^000000.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
感谢你远道而来参观我们的公会。然而，我很遗憾地通知你，铁匠公会已经搬到了修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德的^3131FF‘艾音布罗克’^000000。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
You can travel to Schwarzwald Republic by using the airship.
I can provide you a teleport service to Izlude, where you can use the airship.
Would you like to move to Izlude immediately?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
你可以使用飞空艇前往修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德。
我可以为你提供传送到依斯鲁得岛的服务，在那里你可以使用飞空艇。
你想立即移动到依斯鲁得岛吗？

scripts.text: How to go to Einbroch
scripts.translation: 如何去艾音布罗克

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 是的！

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Oops, haven't you used the airship yet?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
哎呀，你还没用过飞空艇吗？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Unlike Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, Schwarzwald Republic has 'the airship' instead of teleport services to move between towns.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
与卢恩·米德加兹王国不同，修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国使用‘飞空艇’而不是传送服务在城镇之间移动。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
In ^3131FF'Izlude'^000000, you can use ^3131FF'the international airship'^000000 which travels between ^3131FFIzlude and Juno in Schwarzwald Republic^000000.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
在^3131FF‘依斯鲁得岛’^000000，你可以使用^3131FF‘国际飞空艇’^000000，它在^3131FF依斯鲁得岛和修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德的朱诺之间^000000航行。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Take the airship, and go to Juno. Then from Juno, you need to take ^3131FFthe domestic airship^000000 to go to Einbroch.
Remember, you are ^3131FFnot going outside of the airport^000000 upon transit from the international to the domestic airship.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
乘坐飞空艇，前往朱诺。然后从朱诺，你需要乘坐^3131FF国内飞空艇^000000前往艾音布罗克。
记住，在从国际飞空艇中转至国内飞空艇时，你^3131FF不会离开机场^000000。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
It might sound complicated, but you will know once you are in the airport.
When you arrive in Blacksmith Guild, please send my regard to my coworkers!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
这可能听起来很复杂，但一旦你到了机场就会明白。
当你到达铁匠公会时，请代我向我的同事们问好！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Excuse me, but you do not have enough money.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
抱歉，但你没有足够的钱。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Please take care!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
请保重！
